release_notes:
Release v1.4.2 - 2026-11-24

📚 Documentation:
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.4.1 [skip release]

📝 Other Changes:
  • F2: --help of --finops-checks says what is tested: the findings do not change the exit code (security review)
  • F2: MultiAccountConfig.finops_checks is the last field, so positional callers keep working (behaviour review); changelog says so
  • F2: tests: console comparison ignores spinner frames and blank lines; MultiAccountConfig keeps the v1.4.1 positional order (fails: finops_checks sits in the middle) [skip release]
  • F2: guide says a failed listing gives one line per check that needs it; docs and changelog say findings never change the exit code (security review), five languages
  • F2: status page and guide name the --template, no-JSON and no-start-time limits (A-82), five languages; changelog says the same
  • F2: test: a run with and without --finops-checks prints the same console text [skip release]
  • F2: FIN-003 is not_evaluated when the run has no start time; the generator no longer falls back to the clock
  • F2: failing tests: without a run start time FIN-003 is not_evaluated and the clock is never read [skip release]
  • F2: rename the reason units_not_read to listing_not_read (code, changelog, guide in five languages)
  • F2: failing tests: the reason for an unread listing is listing_not_read (the v1.5.0 spec's word) [skip release]
  • F2: drop an unused import
  • F2: per-account scopes read the FinOps result only when the generator has it (stubs without it keep working)
  • F2: docs for --finops-checks in five languages; changelog entry and patch-release sentence
  • F2: docs generator makes a sample of the FinOps sheet [skip release]
  • F2: --finops-checks runs the checks after consolidation; result key, JSON report metadata key and FinOps sheet
  • F2: inventag.finops.checks runs FIN-001 to FIN-006 on scan rows; finops_sheet writes the FinOps sheet
  • F2: tests expect findings sorted by region and resource id as decided (two expectations had the order wrong) [skip release]
  • F2: failing tests for --finops-checks (six checks, FinOps sheet, finops_checks key) [skip release]

📊 Summary: 19 commits in this release
